senses.gloss: Breaking off, leaving off.

a. 
__1 excellent, pre-eminent; पदे पदे सन्ति भटा रणोद्भटाः [[N. 1. 132.]] 
__2 Exalted, magnanimous. 
-टः 
__1 A fan for winnowing corn. 
__2 A tortoise 
-त्वम् weight, importance.

उद्भव,
उद्भावना &c. See under उद्भू.

€1Ā. To shine. -Caus. 
__1 To light up, illuminate, render beautiful, decorate; ornament; उद्भासितं मङ्गलसंबिधाभिः [[R. 7. 16]]; काले घनोद्भासिते [[Mk. 5. 35.]] 
__2 (fig.) To bring into prominence, elevate, exalt; उद्भासिताखिलखलस्य [[Bh. 2. 59.]]
Radiance, splendour.

उद्भासिन्,
उद्भासुर a. Shining, radiant, splendid; विभूषणोद्भासि पिनद्धभोगि बा [[Ku. 5. 78]]; क्रीडारसोद्भासिनि [[Mk. 8. 38]]; [[Bh. 1. 80]]; [[Amaru. 81.]]

€7U. To break up. -pass. To break out, burst forth, become visible, be produced; अद्यापि पक्षाबपि नोद्भिद्येते [[K. 347]]; उद्भिद्यमानपक्षतिः 33, 29, 46; उद्भिन्नपयोधरया [[K. 100]] developed; [[Ve. 4. 10.]] -Caus. To bring out, develop, unfold; बीजानां गर्भितानां फलमतिगहनं गूढमुद्भेदयंश्च [[Mu. 4. 3.]]

a. [उद्-भिद्-क्विप्] 
__1 Sprouting, germinating, shooting forth. 
__2 Penetrating. 
__3 Destroying. 
__4 Causing to come forth. m. 
__1 A sprout or shoot (of a plant); अड्कुरोऽभिनवोद्भिदि [[Ak.]] 
__2 A plant; उद्भिदस्तरुगुल्माद्याः [[Ak.]] 
__3 A spring, fountain. 
-Comp. 
-ज a. (उद्भिज्ज) sprouting, germinating (as a plant). 
(-ज्जः) a plant; उद्भिज्जाः स्थावराः सर्वे बीजकाण्डप्ररोहिणः [[Ms. 1. 46.]] 
-विद्या the science of Botany.

a. Sprouting, germinating. 
-दम् Culinary salt.

p. p. 
__1 Produced, generated, developed; formed; स्वयमेव ब्रह्मबन्धनोद्भिन्नो दुर्गप्रयोगः [[M. 4]]; [[R. 13. 21]]; रविप्रभोद्भिन्नशिरोमणिप्रभः [[Rs. 1. 20.]] 
__2 Shot forth, germinated; नीतिपादपस्य पुष्पमुद्भिन्नम् [[M. 1]]; [[Ku. 1. 24.]] 
__3 Opened, expanded, budded; as in यौबनोद्भिन्नशैशवा. 
__4 Breaking out, appearing; °रोमपुलकैः [[Ch. P. 34]]; [[Ś. 6.]] 
__5 Betrayed; उद्भिन्नास्मि सहवासिन्या विस्रम्भेण [[Māl. 7]]; [[Kām. 17. 45.]]

उद्भेदः,
 
-दनम् 
__1 Breaking through or out, becoming visible, appearance, display, manifestation, growth, development; किसलयोद्भेदप्रतिद्वन्द्विभिः [[Ś. 4. 5]]; उमास्तनोद्भेदमनु प्रवृद्धः [[Ku. 7. 24]]; तं यौबनोद्भेदबिशेषकान्तम् [[R. 5. 38]]; [[Śi. 18. 36]]; [[Mu. 5. 3.]] पुष्पोद्भेदं शरकिसलयैर्भूषणानां विशेषात् । [[Me. 76.]] 
__2 Breaking, splitting; प्रस्तरोद्भेदयोग्यः [[U. 3. 25.]] 
__3 A spring, fountain. 
__4 Horripilation; as in पुलकोद्भेद, रोमोद्भेद, 
__5 Treason, betrayal.

€1P. 
__1 To arise, spring up, be produced from; उदभून्मुरजध्वनिः, अन्तरीक्षात्सरस्वती &c. see उद्भव below. 
__2 To occur, take place; उदभवत्तीव्रो दुर्भिक्षः [[Ks. 27. 94.]] 
__3 To ascend, go up, mount. 
__4 To suffice. 
__5 To rise in arms, revolt, rebel. -Caus. 
__1 To cause to exist, create, produce; मायां मयोद्भाव्य परीक्षितोसि [[R. 2. 62.]] 
__2 To proclaim; माहात्म्यम् [[K. 109.]] 
__3 To use, employ. 
__4 To raise, elevate. 
__5 To consider, think; [[Vikr. 9. 19.]]

__1 Production, creation, birth, generation (lit. and fig.); इति हेतुस्तदुद्भवे [[K. P. 1]]; [[Y. 3. 80]]; the place or object of origin; मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम् [[Bg. 10. 34]]; oft. at the end of comp. in the sense of ‘springing or arising from’, ‘produced from’; ऊरूद्भवा [[V. 1. 3]]; मणिराकरोद्भवः [[R. 3. 18.]] 
__2 Source, origin; उद्भवो यशसः [[K. 54.]] 
__3 N. of Viṣṇu; उद्भबः क्षोभणो देबः [[V. Sah.]] 
-Comp. 
-कर a. productive. 
-क्षेत्रम् birth-place.

__1 Production, generation. 
__2 Magnanimity.

__1 Thinking, thinking over. 
__2 Production, generation, creation; [[Mb. 13.]] 
__3 Speaking, saying. 
__4 Inattention, neglect, disregard.
a. Raising upwards, lifting up, exalting (fig. also); उद्भाबयिता बन्धून् [[Dk. 153.]]

p. p.

__2 Lofty (lit. and fig.). 
__3 Visible, perceptible, capable of being perceived by the senses; as a गुण.

f.

€1, 4. P. To wander, roam about; धाबत्युद्भ्रमति प्रमीलति पतत्युद्याति मूर्छत्यपि [[Gīt. 4.]]

__4 Come on by breaking (the earth); स तमभ्रमिवाविष्टमुद्भ्रान्तमिव मोदिनीम् [[Rām. 7. 31. 14.]] [Page0431-2] 
__5 Wandering upwards.
